free_tier.stated: 10 GB of storage free with 1 million state-change operations and 10 million state-read operations

egress.terms: Zero egress fees at any volume: '出口费：无，重要的是无限流量，适合分发文件', and the rate card states 'Egress fees None'. This is the only reason the provider is in the survey

tooling: the standard S3 API, so rclone s3 and any S3 SDK apply
chaining: 10 GB per account with no card needed and no egress charge is 50 accounts for 500 GB, which is absurd for the volume but worth noting for the egress model alone. The paid rate at USD 6.14/TB/month with genuinely free egress is a solid second to the cheapest paid option

limits.value: 10 GB is the free tier total, which is the cap in practice
public buckets appear to require KYC: '开公开桶似乎要KYC认证'

identity_cost.detail: an email address. The forum reports the 10 GB tier needs no card: '免费10G 不用绑卡好像也没流量费'. A public bucket adds a KYC step

reliability_note: A telecom company diversifying into object storage, and the zero-egress term is real. The 10 GB cap and the KYC step on public buckets are what close it for a user. The pricing page now frames the product around egress to inference, so the object-storage-only customer is no longer the commercial focus

evidence.proved: 'Storage USD 0.006 per GiB (billed monthly)' 'Egress fees None'; 'State-change operations USD 0.50 per million'; 'USD 60.00 Per month ... 10,000 GB STORED'. The API path advertised on the page, GET /v2/public/pricing, returns 404
'免费额度：10GB存储空间，出口费：无，但是有一个缺点，开公开桶似乎要KYC认证'
'免费10G 不用绑卡好像也没流量费'

price_per_tb_month: USD 6.14/TB/month at USD 0.006/GiB, with no egress charge at any volume
binding_note: 10 GB free is 2% of the filter, so the quota closes it. On the paid tier the egress term is the best in the survey and the storage rate at USD 6.14/TB/month is three times the floor.
notes: Recorded because the corpus's storage topic carries two Telnyx records that disagree, one calling it fails-egress on the KYC gate and one calling it qualifies on the zero-egress rate card. Both are about the same product at different tiers: the free 10 GB tier is closed by size and KYC, and the paid tier is open and priced. This record is the pan-topic view and is named so it does not collide with the storage record.

extras.slug_note: the ledger reserved 'telnyx-cloud-storage', which dossier/storage/telnyx-cloud-storage.json already holds. This record is the pan-topic view and takes a distinct slug so the two do not collide
